construct: .cf-a { transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.645, 0.045, 0.355, 1) } — a transition declared on a CHILD PART, not the root (antd's `motionDurationMid` on every interactive part)
why: The root-level transition case is green; antd puts its transitions on parts (the Switch handle, the Checkbox inner, the close icon). Nothing in the canvas vocabulary spells motion, so the honest treatment is a DECLARED fact per part with its own canvas verdict — not silence on every part but the root (P2 exam S5).

canvas.note: no canvas spelling — the channel is a DECLARED fact on the part with its own canvas verdict, which is the honest treatment, not a loss
